name: rewrite a SQL query to be SQLite-valid and equivalent to a reference
definition: Produce a SQLite query that parses/runs and returns exactly the reference result set, structured for performance.
failure_mode: Non-SQLite syntax or dialect-dependent constructs fail to parse at test time.

name: run an mteb STS12 evaluation and meet the spearman threshold
definition: execute the STSEval benchmark for the chosen model and obtain a cosine-spearman test score above 0.7.
failure_mode: a weak model, mis-config, or incomplete run yields a below-threshold or missing metric

name: sample a large dataset from the intervened model and persist it
definition: draw a fixed number of rows from the intervened joint over the original columns and write a CSV preserving the original column names.
failure_mode: wrong column count/names or non-parametric samples fail the checks

name: save dag edges as a from,to csv file
definition: write directed edge records as a two-column CSV with the required header and each parental relation oriented correctly.
failure_mode: missing headers or swapped endpoints fail the structural checks
